card.description: A vast, vaulted sky temple perched on a jagged plateau, its basaltic walls etched with luminous glyphs that pulse in sync with an unseen celestial engine. The structure blends the monolithic columns of Ethiopian rock-hewn churches with towering Egyptian obelisks, all wired with translucent crystalline conduits that glow with bioluminescent energy. The air hums with low-frequency resonance, and a swirling nebula overhead serves as both backdrop and living interface, casting a soft, otherworldly glow across the stone and metal.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Massive stone temple with basalt columns, Egyptian-style obelisks, vaulted ceilings, integrated crystalline conduits.
**Face/Sensors:** Central sky dome featuring a crystalline lattice that functions as a sensor array, projecting glyphs across the interior.
**Key Features:** Luminous glyphs, bioluminescent conduits, runic control panels, celestial engine, swirling nebula interface.
evolution: Phase 1 (Default): The temple stands in twilight, its glyphs pulsing softly, the nebula swirling overhead.
props: Item: Celestial Orb – a polished obsidian sphere that channels energy.
Item: Runic Control Panel – a stone slab with embedded crystal glyphs that can be activated.
